text:
priya: Heads up — rolling RBAC role-split to main yesterday looks like it regressed the console: some users with 'viewer' are seeing the Edit button on Projects. Not widespread but reproduced in 2 orgs. Can someone triage?
marco: oh no. repro steps?
priya: repro: login as org B user with role=viewer via SSO. Go to Project > Settings > click edit. Button is visible and returns 403 on submit. Screenshot attached (not in thread).
omar: is the API returning allow=true or is it just UI?
priya: frontend shows button enabled (so gating failed client-side). API denies on POST /projects/:id (403). So UI and API disagree.
marco: likely cause: frontend still maps old role slugs. We changed role enums to namespaced slugs in the migration. Quick check: frontend maps 'viewer' -> canEdit=false, but new backend uses 'role:project.viewer' etc. I'll grep.
marco: found it — frontend role map still checks `role === 'viewer'` not `role.startsWith('project.viewer')`.
priya: thanks — so client assumes old shape and shows button; API correctly denies. That explains mismatch. We need a short-term fix (hide button) and a medium fix (sync role shape).
jen: customer-facing impact? any orgs affected with active editing while 403ing?
priya: 2 orgs reported, low risk, but editing attempts fail which is confusing. Need fix before next deploy.
omar: also, audit logs for those failed POSTs show event=project.update, result=denied, user_id present. Can we attach these to an incident?
sec-bot: Automated audit note: created audit record id=AUDIT-20240315-9f3a; linked to ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1239
ops-bot: KMS rotation job ran yesterday at 02:12 UTC on key alias projects/console; no errors logged.
priya: hmm curious — could KMS alias rename have affected role tokens? doubtful but check token claims.
marco: frontend fix is trivial: treat both legacy and namespaced slugs for now. Patch in 5m.
marco: patch: ```js
// tolerate both role formats during migration
const canEdit = ['editor','admin','project.editor','project.admin'].includes(user.role);
```
priya: also need backend hardening — API should not rely on client. Ensure server-side permission check strictly verifies role scope. Current snippet in service: ```python
def can_edit(user, project):
    return user.role in ["editor", "admin"] and user.org_id == project.org_id
```
omar: that does look old. We migrated to scoped roles but left this helper unchanged. I'll open a backend PR to check for `role.endswith('editor')` AND parse namespace.
jen: for immediate mitigation, can we kill the Edit button via feature flag so no more confused requests?
priya: yes — set `console:ui:project-edit` false in prod for 10m while we patch.
omar: command: `rctl flags set console:ui:project-edit false --env=prod`
priya: doing it now.
sec-bot: Feature flag change registered by omar at 2024-03-15T09:07:12Z; change id=FF-5782
marco: frontend patch merged to hotfix branch, deploying to prod canary now.
marco: also added temporary tolerance for namespaced slugs. Follow-up: remove tolerance after full rollout and unify mapping.
priya: backend PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/backend/pull/512 — updating permission helper and adding regression test and audit event on mismatched role shapes.
omar: added KMS/audit check to the PR: ensures token claims are validated and logs key alias used for signing. Also noted KMS rotation had no impact.
jen: next steps: communications? small email to affected orgs + status page update?
priya: agreed. I'll draft a short note. Also scheduling a postmortem to cover migration checklist: migration scripts, frontend compatibility, automated telemetry for UI/API mismatch.
priya: triage checklist for now: 1) feature flag off (done) 2) frontend hotfix deployed (in progress) 3) backend PR review and deploy (in progress) 4) attach audit records to SEC ticket (sec-bot did) 5) PM/customer note (jen)
oms: any other concerns re: KMS logs or rotation?
omar: just confirming we record key aliases in audit trail going forward — added to backend PR.
sec-bot: Reminder: create postmortem template entry: SEC-INC-20240315-RBAC-MIGRATE in ops playbook.
priya: thanks all — loop back once backend is live, otherwise revert feature flag back on. :thumbsup:
marco: backend is green in staging; smoke looks good. Will monitor metrics.
marco: prod canary shows no edit buttons in sampled sessions.
priya: closing loop — re-enable feature flag when backend deploy completes.
priya: assigning follow-ups: @marco remove tolerance by EOD, @omar ensure KMS alias telemetry stays in logs, @jen send customer note.
jen: on it.
priya: creating postmortem stub: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1240
ops-bot: Audit linkage: AUDIT-20240315-9f3a attached to SEC-1239 and SEC-1240.
